value.rationale: The dodecahedron is the canonical girth-five cubic planar extremal graph for optimum cycle breaking; exact edge-adjacent mobility of every optimum is mathematically different from known unrestricted exchange. The new connectedness, sharp ten-step bound, detailed eccentricities and two internally connected optimum strata give substantive local-optimization geometry, not merely another total count.
